ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_DepositAccountStatus_DEP
AS
BEGIN

--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_DepositAccountStatus AS 
(
    -- SBCA_MAST_TABLE
    SELECT
    BDGM.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BDC.ACCT_STATUS_DATE AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,BDC.ACCT_STATUS AS DepositAccountStatusTypeId
    ,'CASA' AS DepositTypeId
    ,NULL AS DepositAccountStatusNote
    ,BDC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BDC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
    ,BDCD.RECORD_STATUS
    FROM BUSC.DEP_CASAMASTER_DELTA BDCD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_CASAMASTER BDC ON BDCD.ACID = BDC.ACID AND BDCD.BANK_ID = BDC.BANK_ID AND BDC.ISLATEST = 1 
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDGM ON BDGM.ACID = BDC.ACID AND BDC.ISLATEST = 1

    UNION ALL

    -- TD_ACCT_MASTER_TABLE
    SELECT
    BDGM.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BDT.ACCT_STATUS_DATE AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,BDT.ACCT_STATUS AS DepositAccountStatusTypeId
    ,'TD' AS DepositTypeId
    ,NULL AS DepositAccountStatusNote
    ,BDT.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BDT.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
    ,BDTD.RECORD_STATUS
    FROM BUSC.DEP_TDMASTER_DELTA BDTD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_TDMASTER BDT ON BDTD.ACID = BDT.ACID AND BDTD.BANK_ID = BDT.BANK_ID AND BDT.ISLATEST = 1 
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDGM ON BDGM.ACID = BDT.ACID AND BDT.ISLATEST = 1

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_DepositAccountStatus FROM TEMP_BNKM_DepositAccountStatus WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_DepositAccountStatus_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
    CustomerAccountId
    ,PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,DepositAccountStatusTypeId
    ,DepositTypeId
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_DepositAccountStatus WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_DepositAccountStatus_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
    CustomerAccountId
    ,PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,DepositAccountStatusTypeId
    ,DepositTypeId
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
FROM BNKM.DepositAccountStatus --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'CCD'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_DepositAccountStatus_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	 
FROM TEMP_BNKM_DepositAccountStatus_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_DepositAccountStatus_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_DepositAccountStatus_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_DepositAccountStatus_DELTA;

---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
    ,PeriodStartTimestamp = SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,PeriodEndTimestamp = NULL
    ,DepositAccountStatusTypeId = SRC.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
    ,DepositTypeId = SRC.DepositTypeId
    ,DepositAccountStatusNote = NULL
    ,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
    ,SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'  
    ,WorkFlowId = 0
	,TaskRunId = 0
	,InsertDttm = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.DepositAccountStatus TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_DepositAccountStatus_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_DepositAccountStatus SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId ;

 

--INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.DepositAccountStatus
(
    CustomerAccountId
    ,PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,DepositAccountStatusTypeId
    ,DepositTypeId
    ,DepositAccountStatusNote
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
	SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
    ,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,SRC.PeriodEndTimestamp AS PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,SRC.DepositAccountStatusTypeId AS DepositAccountStatusTypeId
    ,SRC.DepositTypeId AS DepositTypeId
    ,SRC.DepositAccountStatusNote AS DepositAccountStatusNote
    ,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode  
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_DepositAccountStatus SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_DepositAccountStatus_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE';


-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.DepositAccountStatus
(
    CustomerAccountId
    ,PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,DepositAccountStatusTypeId
    ,DepositTypeId
    ,DepositAccountStatusNote
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
)
SELECT distinct
	CustomerAccountId
    ,PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,DepositAccountStatusTypeId
    ,DepositTypeId
    ,NULL AS DepositAccountStatusNote
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode 
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_DepositAccountStatus
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_DepositAccountStatus;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_DepositAccountStatus_DELTA;


END
